تعتوروا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَوِرُوا (taʕtawirū) /taʕ.ta.wi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# تُعْتَوَرُوا (tuʕtawarū) /tuʕ.ta.wa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
